effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may return 1 card with [Greymon], [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name from your trash to the hand.
[All Turns] When your Digimon or Tamers are played or digivolve, if any of them have [Garurumon] or [Tai Kamiya] in their names, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Greymon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Omnimon] in text or w/[ADVENTURE] trait: Cost 2
